title: · Vantage | BVLGARI Kaleidos Exhibition ·
original_title: 视野 | BVLGARI 宝格丽“Kaleidos 万花绮镜”特展
excerpt: BVLGARI's Shanghai exhibition showcases 300 jewel-toned creations and Chinese art, celebrating color and craftsmanship from September to October 2026.
author: 撰稿 X Zoey 编辑 X Vivi

blocks.text: From September 5 to October 31, 2026, BVLGARI's 'Kaleidos: Color, Culture, and Craftsmanship' exhibition arrives at the Power Station of Art in Shanghai. Featuring over 300 jewel-toned creations and contemporary Chinese artworks, visitors are invited to wander through a world of dazzling hues.

The exhibition's name, 'Kaleidos,' draws from the Greek 'kalos' (beauty) and 'eidos' (form). Curated across three chapters—'The Science of Colors,' 'Color Symbolism,' and 'The Power of Light'—it showcases over 300 high jewelry pieces, alongside creations from BVLGARI's Heritage Collection and private collections. This vivid narrative brings to life Bulgari's world of craftsmanship and creativity, while offering a fresh perspective on Eastern and Western color philosophies.

Notably, the exhibition also features works by Chinese artists Liang Manqi and Zhang Ding. As a key component of the Shanghai stop, these artworks bring contemporary Chinese creative expression to the fore, reinterpreting and enriching the exhibition's narrative through the lens of Chinese culture, philosophy, and artistic tradition.

BVLGARI 'Kaleidos' Exhibition Dates: September 5 - October 31, 2026 Hours: 11:00 - 19:00 (last entry one hour before closing) Closed on Mondays (except public holidays) Venue: Power Station of Art, 678 Miaojiang Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai Admission: 60 RMB (reservation required via the 'Explore Bulgari' mini-program)
